message.content:
Both edits applied. Now update the checklist and HANDOFF.md to reflect milestone 2 coverage.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# Update checklist with milestone-2 coverage
p = 'specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md'
s = open(p).read()

old = '''- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-013 each state a
  concrete observable behavior)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-005)'''
new = '''- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-021 each state a
  concrete observable behavior; milestone 2 R04-R06 added 2026-10-17)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-008)'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)

old = '''- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (14 Given/When/Then scenarios)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (8 edge cases)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (additive module; A6, A7)'''
new = '''- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (23 Given/When/Then scenarios across
  User Stories 1-4)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (15 edge cases, incl. empty-all-tags, resize
  no-op/empty, generator single-consumption, absolute-expiry preservation)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (additive module; A6, A7; conflicting design
  note superseded per A9)'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)

old = '''## Notes

- All items pass; no spec updates required before `$speckit-plan`.
- Traceability: FR-001..FR-013 map to milestone requirements R01 (FR-002..004),
  R02 (FR-005..FR-009), R02 extension/Claim-A (FR-010), R03 (FR-001, FR-011,
  FR-012), and API preservation (FR-013).'''
new = '''## Notes

- All items pass; spec updated 2026-10-17 for milestone 2 (R04-R06) and the
  round-2 R05 clarification; no spec updates required before `$speckit-plan`.
- Traceability: FR-001..FR-021 map to milestone requirements R01
  (FR-002..004), R02 (FR-005..FR-009), R02 extension/Claim-A (FR-010), R03
  (FR-001, FR-011, FR-012), API preservation (FR-013), R04 (FR-014..016), R05
  (FR-017, FR-018), R05 clarification round 2 (FR-019), R06 (FR-020, FR-021).
- Conflicting old design note ('empty all-tags matches every key and resizing
  may flush the cache') is superseded by R04/R05 (A9) and MUST NOT be relied
  upon.'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('checklist ok')

# Update HANDOFF.md
h = 'HANDOFF.md'
t = open(h).read()
old = '''- specify: done (specs/001-transactions/spec.md + checklists/requirements.md,
  all checklist items pass, 0 NEEDS CLARIFICATION)'''
new = '''- specify: done (specs/001-transactions/spec.md + checklists/requirements.md,
  all checklist items pass, 0 NEEDS CLARIFICATION; updated 2026-10-17 for
  milestone 2 R04-R06 + round-2 R05 clarification, FR-014..FR-021, A9-A11)'''
assert old in t
t = t.replace(old, new, 1)

old = '''  Disposition (A8): active requirement FR-010; variant label is traceability
  only and does NOT override the refresh behavior.'''
new = '''  Disposition (A8): active requirement FR-010; variant label is traceability
  only and does NOT override the refresh behavior.
- R04: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'); any=union, all=intersection;
  empty requested tags remove zero in both modes (NOT match-all); returns
  distinct removed-key count; invalid mode/tags rejected before mutation;
  invalidate(tag) stays compatible.
- R05: resize(maxsize) positive non-bool int first; shrink evicts LRU,
  grow never evicts; failed resize preserves all state; maxsize property
  reports current capacity.
- R05 clarification (round 2, 2026-09-22): resize preserves each surviving
  entry's ABSOLUTE expiry (R07/R08 define expiry as entry state); dropping or
  recomputing expiries from resize time violates R05. Recorded as FR-019;
  no expiry is implemented until R07/R08 land (A10).
- R06: tags may be generators, consumed exactly once; returned values stay
  detached across repeated gets/puts incl. nested list/dict.
- Superseded conflicting note (A9): 'empty all-tags matches every key and
  resizing may flush the cache' is asserted prose overridden by R04/R05.'''
assert old in t
t = t.replace(old, new, 1)
open(h, 'w').write(t)
print('handoff ok')
PYEOF"}
